combo_label: At the Cinema × The Lake District × Thunderbirds

entries.clue: Pass with a one-in-three gradient and a Roman fort perched at its western end
Family name of the flying brothers and their millionaire father
Fast-cut montage flogging a film that is not out yet
Torch-carrying attendant who guides latecomers to their row
Fish hawk back since 2001 at Bassenthwaite, the one water here named a lake
Palm-fringed speck in the ocean, hollowed out to hide extraordinary machines
Number of rescuing sons in the family, matching the count of their numbered craft
Shabby little picture house, affectionately insulted
Given name of the Creighton-Ward aristocrat, the London end of the operation
Bare upland hill of the north, a word the Vikings brought over as fjall
Neolithic tool for chopping timber, quarried in green stone in the central valleys
Sloping walkway you shuffle along, trampling toes, to reach mid-row
